title: Measure full-rebuild amplification for one deterministic relation delta

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Stop constructor micro-optimization and quantify the current full-rebuild tax for a tiny same-plane Boolean relation delta without implementing an incremental backend. Reuse KnowledgeForest, FourfoldSnapshot and compile_relation_blocks as the only semantic/projection owners. Keep axis membership fixed, add exactly one retained relation fact, and separately pin fail-closed behavior for partial endpoint planes.

measurement.authority: diagnostic only; KnowledgeForest/Fourfold remain semantic authority and compile_relation_blocks remains the only projection owner

wall_timing_ms.interpretation: These are ordinary full-rebuild timings on the hosted Python 3.12.14 Linux runner. The near-equal medians are not an incremental speedup result because no incremental implementation exists.

measurement.semantic_delta: The base and delta Forests have identical 512-node code-plane membership. The delta revision adds exactly src/node_0000.py -> src/node_0017.py with relation imports; no coordinate is removed.
measurement.unsupported_behavior: The same delta Forest bound to a partial code plane is refused with 'relation compilation requires complete endpoint planes; code=partial' before sparse zeroes can be interpreted as complete facts.
measurement.finding: For this frozen case, one changed semantic coordinate causes the current canonical full rebuild to scan and reconstruct 8193 selected relation facts. This is deterministic 8193:1 work-scope amplification evidence and a measured full-rebuild construction cost around 140-145 ms on the hosted runner. It does not measure or prove an incremental speedup, memory win or Tensor-over-Forest advantage.

semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: KnowledgeForest/Fourfold remain authoritative; the probe never becomes a graph or fact owner.
semantic_invariants.projection_owner: compile_relation_blocks is invoked unchanged for base, delta and refusal cases.
semantic_invariants.closed_world: Selected relation endpoint planes must remain complete; partial code is refused.
semantic_invariants.fixed_axes: Base and delta snapshots retain identical code node membership so the measurement isolates one relation-fact delta rather than axis churn.
semantic_invariants.canonical_output: No trusted constructor, validation bypass, persistent cache, second block type or production delta API is introduced.
semantic_invariants.bounded_memory: The diagnostic materializes only two bounded synthetic Forest/Snapshot inputs plus ordinary compiler outputs and timing samples.
semantic_invariants.public_api: No public API, wire schema, authority or promotion contract changes.

result.summary: GPU-100 closes with retained CI evidence: one added Boolean relation coordinate under fixed axes requires the current full rebuild to scan and reconstruct 8193 selected facts in the frozen 512x16 case. The diagnostic preserves Fourfold/Forest authority, complete-plane refusal and the single compile_relation_blocks owner; it implements no incremental backend and makes no superiority claim.
